criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: General COVID-19 Information
categories.definition: User seeks broad or introductory information about COVID-19, its nature, or general understanding.

categories.name: Symptoms and Personal Health Assessment
categories.definition: User asks about specific COVID-19 symptoms, their severity, duration, or seeks to compare their own symptoms to COVID-19.

categories.name: Transmission and Prevention
categories.definition: User asks how COVID-19 spreads, how to protect themselves or others, or about general safety measures.

categories.name: Surface and Object Contamination
categories.definition: User asks about the virus's viability on surfaces or objects, or how to disinfect them.

categories.name: High-Risk Areas and Exposure
categories.definition: User asks about locations or situations considered high-risk for COVID-19 exposure, or what to do after potential exposure.

categories.name: Self-Quarantine and Isolation
categories.definition: User asks for guidance on self-quarantine or isolation practices.

categories.name: Treatment and Cure Information
categories.definition: User asks about available treatments, potential cures, or vaccine development for COVID-19.

categories.name: Statistics and Case Data
categories.definition: User asks for numerical data related to COVID-19 cases, deaths, recoveries, or testing in specific regions or demographics.

categories.name: News and Updates
categories.definition: User seeks current news, press releases, or general updates about the COVID-19 pandemic.

categories.name: COVID-19 Myths and Misinformation
categories.definition: User asks to confirm or debunk common myths, rumors, or false claims about COVID-19.

categories.name: Travel Restrictions and Advice
categories.definition: User asks about travel bans, restrictions, safety of travel methods, or advice for traveling during the pandemic.

categories.name: Pets and Animals
categories.definition: User asks about COVID-19's impact on pets or other animals, or transmission between animals and humans.

categories.name: Donation and Funding
categories.definition: User expresses intent to donate money or asks for information on how to contribute to COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Sharing Service Information
categories.definition: User expresses intent to share information about the current service or bot with others.

categories.name: Greetings and Gratitude
categories.definition: User expresses a greeting, thanks, or general positive sentiment towards the service or bot.
